title: apps.humation.app listing
description: One listing on apps.humation.app. Lives at apps/<slug>/app.json in https://github.com/humation-labs/apps.humation.app. The slug is the directory name: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, 3-40 characters.

tagline.description: One-line pitch shown on the card and under the name. No trailing period.

description.description: Plain text, 1-4 short paragraphs separated by blank lines. No Markdown, no HTML, no URLs. Explain what the app does and how it uses Humation avatars.

url.description: Primary link for the Open button. Must be https and publicly reachable.

packages.description: Humation packages the app actually depends on. Verified from the project's dependency files.

usage.description: Optional one sentence on where avatars appear in the app, e.g. 'User profile pictures and comment threads'.

name.description: Person or organization name shown as the developer.

github.description: GitHub user or organization login, without @. Should be the PR author or their organization.

icon.description: Always icon.png in the listing directory: PNG, exactly 512x512, at most 512 KB, square, no rounded-corner mask (the site applies it).

screenshots.description: Files under screenshots/ in the listing directory. PNG, JPEG or WebP; shorter side at least 640 px, longer side at most 3000 px, at most 2 MB each. All screenshots should share one orientation.

alt.description: What the screenshot shows, for accessibility.

addedAt.description: Date the listing was submitted, YYYY-MM-DD. Set once; do not change on later edits.
